description: This file defines a plugin component for generating a cryptographically secure password within a web-based rich text editor using the Lexical framework. It exports a function that creates a password plugin object with properties like name, icon, keywords, and an onSelect handler to insert a password of default length.

methods.name: GetPasswordBlock
methods.description: Creates a plugin object for password generation in the editor, with an onSelect handler that dispatches a command to insert a password of default length.
